SysInt Inc brings together enterprise integration, cloud modernization, and applied AI engineering. We help businesses connect applications, data, APIs, and knowledge systems so intelligence can operate within real business processes — securely, reliably, and at scale.

About SysInt Inc

SysInt Inc is focused on helping businesses modernize platforms, connect systems, and operationalize AI. With strong experience across enterprise architecture, middleware, APIs, cloud workflows, and intelligent automation, we build solutions that are practical, scalable, and aligned to business outcomes.

What makes us different

We understand both worlds: the complexity of long-running enterprise systems and the speed of modern AI innovation. That means we do not treat AI as an isolated experiment. We integrate it into the platforms, approvals, data flows, and operating models that businesses already depend on.

Azure Integration Services and enterprise integration expertise

Connecting ERP, CRM, SCM, legacy systems, SaaS applications, APIs, messaging platforms, and cloud services through robust middleware and modern integration layers.

Enterprise Integration

SysInt Inc helps organizations integrate business-critical systems through APIs, workflows, messaging, event-driven patterns, and middleware architecture. We connect operational platforms across finance, supply chain, customer engagement, partner ecosystems, and legacy environments to create a reliable digital backbone for the business.

From BizTalk to Azure

With more than 20 years of BizTalk experience and deep expertise in Azure Integration Services, SysInt Inc supports organizations as they move beyond traditional integration estates. As it becomes time to move out from BizTalk, we help assess existing interfaces, preserve business knowledge, reduce migration risk, and design modern Azure-based solutions that improve agility, observability, maintainability, and long-term scalability.

Modernization with continuity

We do not just replace technology. We translate proven integration patterns, business flows, partner connections, and operational controls into cloud-ready architectures that support future growth and AI-enabled transformation.
